name: Voxel Renderer with Top-Level Grid and Bricks
aliases: Brick-based voxel rendering with dynamic synchronization
definition: A voxel renderer that uses a two-level grid structure: a top-level grid containing 'bricks' (8x8x8 voxel blocks), where only changed bricks are synchronized to the GPU to optimize data transfer.
summary: This method renders voxel data using a two-level grid to optimize memory transfer and cache locality by synchronizing only changed 8x8x8 bricks.
